shortDescription: On Polymarket, the “Over” option in the “Tampa Bay Rays O/U 4.5” submarket for the Tampa Bay Rays vs. Milwaukee Brewers event fell to 23.5% from 57% one hour earlier, a 33.5-percentage-point drop. According to ChainCatcher, the probability was monitored on Polymarket.
